items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Cab wanted me on also... We caught Cab Calloway's band came in there one night

ctx.x: I said, Bean -- we used to call him Bean for short -- if we could call him -- well, I always called him Hawk. I said, "hey Bean" (unintelligible), why don't you play the clarinet?" He said, "that's why I asked you to join us when I met you in Chicago. He said, we liked your style because you was swinging with the clarinet." So I was doubling on — . Mainly I was doubling from the alto to the tenor and -- but we got in New York, and I sort of worked with from alto Benny. And I stayed on alto and then switched to…
